purchase: Buy one or five units with coins in Toko Jalan, then choose Pasang and drag over clear land.
ownership: One placed cell consumes one unit. Erasing returns its style to stock, not coins. Replacing a style returns the old unit and consumes one new unit.
storage: Road inventory is separate from harvest storage.
migration: Existing road arrays remain valid; old roads become Batu Pastel. The legacy key array remains in saves alongside style and stock metadata.
appearance: Individual illustrated isometric stone, brick and mossy stone pavers, tessellated over the original purchased road footprint. No wooden plank variant.
wood_migration: Old wood stock and selected type convert once to moss stone. Placed wood roads also load as moss stone.
